data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 双手捧稳的双层汉堡
data.description: 明亮的快餐店里，阿尔托莉雅穿深蓝针织开衫、白色翻领衬衫和裙装坐在桌旁，双手分别托住双层芝士汉堡的两侧，小心张口咬下一口。她的碧绿眼睛专注地看着汉堡，脸颊微微鼓起，金色盘发上的蓝丝带整齐垂落。桌上是素色纸托盘与一杯饮料，大片窗光照亮她满足的神情。
data.action: 双手托住双层汉堡两侧，微微前倾咬下一口，目光落在食物上。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
data.promptProse: At a window-side fast-food table, Artoria Pendragon holds a double cheeseburger securely at both sides and leans forward to bite it, her green eyes on the food. Retain the dark-blue cardigan, white collared shirt and skirt, blonde braided bun, blue ribbon and upright ahoge. In the seated eye-level medium shot, the paper tray fills the lower edge and the drink stands beside it. The window ledge continues behind her toward a farther booth, giving the restaurant a readable depth without distracting diners. Broad daylight reaches her cheek and the burger bun; the cup leaves a soft oval shadow on the table, and its pale reflection touches the tray edge.
